attributes.action: Return Venezuela’s gold held in the Bank of England
attributes.additional_details: Venezuela’s June 2026 earthquakes killed thousands, with 50,000 still missing, in a country already suffering under severe economic sanctions. Venezuela has formally requested the return of 31 tonnes of its gold, held by the Bank of England, now worth approximately £3.5 billion given the rise in gold prices since it was frozen. Despite the evident and desperate need for recovery funds, the gold has not been returned. Thirty cross-party MPs, already back its return.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government to secure the return of the over 30 tonnes of Venezuela’s gold — currently valued at approximately £3.5 billion — held in the Bank of England, to help fund earthquake recovery.

rejection.details:
We can't accept your petition because it's about something that the UK Government or Parliament is not responsible for.

The Bank of England is independent of the UK Government and Parliament.

You can contact the Bank of England here:

https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/contact
